Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2026

At BrahmaUIXDev, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting any information you share with us through this freelance portfolio website.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect basic contact details (such as your name, email address, phone number, or WhatsApp number) only when you voluntarily reach out to us through the contact form or WhatsApp link.

2. How We Use Your Information

Information shared with us is used solely to respond to your inquiries, discuss potential projects, and provide our design & development services. We do not use it for marketing without your consent.

3. Data Security

Any contact form data is transmitted securely and stored confidentially. We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect it from unauthorized access or disclosure.

4. Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with any third parties. Communication via WhatsApp is governed by WhatsApp's own privacy policy.

5. Cookies & Analytics

This website does not use intrusive tracking cookies. Basic analytics may be used solely to understand visitor trends and improve the site.

6. Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal data you have shared with us by contacting us via WhatsApp at +91 99388 15347.

7. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page.

By using this website or contacting us, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.
